name: School of Shadow Veils

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You've received brutal instruction in shadow and illusion magic from the shadowcallers of the Duskhall.

Curriculum
- cantrips: Figment, Frostbite

- 1st: Disguise Magic, Gloom Mantle,  illusory object

- 2nd: Darkness, Illusory Creature

- 3rd: Shadow Projectile, Shared Invisibility

- 4th: Liminal Doorway, Mirage

- 5th: Shadow Blast, Slither

- 6th: Mislead, Phantasmal Calamity

- 7th: Mask of Terror, Shadow Form

- 8th: Disappearance

- 9th: Phantasmagoria

School Spells initial: The Night is Mine; advanced: Tenebrous Freedom
